stories.title: Record crowd of more than 5,000 at Flint RNLI fireworks display at Flint Castle
stories.summary: More than 5,000 people turned out for Flint RNLI’s annual fireworks display at Flint Castle on Friday night, according to the lifeboat station. stories.title: Water supplies affected in Flint, Bagillt and Gronant on Saturday evening
stories.summary: Homes in parts of Flint and Bagillt may have no water or low pressure this evening, Welsh Water has said. The water company is dealing with a supply problem in Oakenholt and surrounding areas of Flint, and a burst water main affecting Foel Gron in Bagillt. stories.title: Halkyn Mountain wildfires raised as climate groups gather at Theatr Clwyd
stories.summary: Clwyd East MP Becky Gittins has pointed to the wildfires on Halkyn Mountain as an example of extreme weather in north Wales, after bringing climate groups together at Theatr Clwyd in Mold. stories.title: First designs for Buckley town centre revamp to go on show at precinct drop-in
stories.summary: The first concept designs for a revamp of Buckley town centre will go on show in Buckley Precinct on Thursday 12 November. stories.title: About three million self-assessment taxpayers to move to regular in-year tax payments
stories.summary: About three million self-assessment taxpayers will pay their income tax in smaller, more regular instalments during the year from April 2029, HMRC has confirmed.
